e.body: 这是**一份 MSc 精算学位论文的配套软件包**（Zenodo 开放获取，2026-09-08，DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22662352`），完整归档了 v1.0.0 论文提交版本（单个 33.6MB zip）。功能覆盖**模拟、准备金评估、敏感性分析与报告**，研究主题是：**理赔通胀、结构性变化，以及 Excess-of-Loss（超赔）合约的指数化条款，如何影响毛准备金与分出准备金的估计**。对 RIAA：这条正好落在本 wiki 两条重要线索的**交叉点上**——**准备金**（[[reservingmodels]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]]、[[ibnr]]、[[chainladder-python]]）与**再保分层**（[[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]]、[[layerloss-locktonre]]、[[retention]]）。它的独特价值在于把三件常在实务中分开讨论的事放在一个模型里：**通胀、结构断点、再保合约指数化**——而这三者恰恰是「分出准备金」估计误差的主要来源；同时它是**可复现包形态**（见另一条同批入库的 [[claims-inflation-motor-my]]），两份 MSc 论文包并列展示同一条思路的两种论文选题（车险通胀链梯 vs XoL 通胀准备金）。适合作准备金、再保定价与通胀方法论方向，以及毕业论文选题参考。
e.body_en: This is the **accompanying software package of an MSc actuarial dissertation** (open access on Zenodo, 2026-09-08, DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22662352`), archiving the exact v1.0.0 submission release (a single 33.6MB zip). It covers **simulation, reserving, sensitivity analysis and reporting**, and studies how **claims inflation, structural change, and excess-of-loss (XoL) treaty indexation** affect gross and ceded reserve estimates. For RIAA: this sits precisely at the **intersection of two important threads** in this wiki — **reserving** ([[reservingmodels]], [[stochastic-reserving-england]], [[ibnr]], [[chainladder-python]]) and **reinsurance layering** ([[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]], [[layerloss-locktonre]], [[retention]]). Its distinctive value is putting three things usually discussed separately into one model: **inflation, structural breaks and reinsurance treaty indexation** — and these are exactly the main sources of error in ceded reserve estimation; it is also a **reproducibility package** (see [[claims-inflation-motor-my]], added in the same batch), and the two MSc packages side by side show two dissertation takes on one idea (motor inflation chain ladder vs inflation-aware XoL reserving). Suits reserving, reinsurance pricing and inflation methodology, plus dissertation topic selection.
e.body_hk: 這是**一份 MSc 精算學位論文的配套軟件包**（Zenodo 開放獲取，2026-09-08，DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22662352`），完整歸檔 v1.0.0 論文提交版本（單個 33.6MB zip）。功能覆蓋**模擬、準備金評估、敏感性分析與報告**，研究主題是：**理賠通脹、結構性變化，以及 Excess-of-Loss（超賠）合約的指數化條款，如何影響毛準備金與分出準備金的估計**。對 RIAA：這正好落在**準備金**（[[reservingmodels]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]]、[[ibnr]]、[[chainladder-python]]）與**再保分層**（[[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]]、[[layerloss-locktonre]]、[[retention]]）兩條線索的**交叉點**。其獨特價值在於把**通脹、結構斷點、再保合約指數化**放進同一個模型——這三者正是「分出準備金」估計誤差的主要來源；同時它是**可復現包形態**（見同批入庫的 [[claims-inflation-motor-my]]）。適合作準備金、再保定價與通脹方法論方向，以及畢業論文選題參考。
